messages:
sara_sales: heads up team — AcmeBank wants the POC demo tomorrow. They asked for deterministic performance on the checkout path: target ~8k tokens/min sustained for ~45 minutes. Theyre insisting on dedicated isolation.

alex_solutions: do we know the exact pool + model? hosted vs dedicated matters for options.

sara_sales: dedicated. pool ded-acme-prodlike-usw2, model = rwlm-7b-compat, currently 2x A10g reserved. Demo start 2026-03-25T21:00Z.

jason_infra: two ways to cover that window:
- temporary reserve an extra GPU for the window (predictable latency)
- increase burst_credit_limit and extend burst_window (cheaper but soft guarantees)

which does sales prefer?

sara_sales: reserve. customer will do a short live demo to execs and needs consistent p95.

maria_security: security asks: can keys be scoped to only target that pool and auto-expire? Also they want request-level audit logs for the window retained 30 days.

keisha_sre: Id also push for a canary 10 minutes before with 5% traffic plus a 5 minute drain cooldown. Add fallback to quantized variant if memory spikes.

alex_solutions: pricing note: for short-term reserves we invoice the extra reserved GPU at the hourly commit. I can approve a 20% one-off demo discount; finance wants a line item after infra confirms.

jason_infra: creating CR. config I'm going to apply:
```
{
  "pool_id": "ded-acme-prodlike-usw2",
  "add_reserve_gpus": 1,
  "reserve_period": "2026-03-25T20:50:00Z/2026-03-25T22:00:00Z",
  "canary": {"pct": 5, "start_before_mins": 10},
  "drain_cooldown_mins": 5,
  "fallback": "rwlm-7b-compat-quant"
}
```

jason_infra: also creating a scoped API key with TTL=1h and attaching logging policy to write inference logs to s3://redwood-acme-poc-logs. Need confirmation for IAM role: redwood-poc-logs-writer.

maria_security: confirmed. I'll issue the key and stash it into their ephemeral vault. Opening audit ticket to set 30d retention on that bucket and enable object-level logs.

deploy-bot: change_request CR-20260325-113 created by jason_infra -> Actions: +1 GPU reserve on ded-acme-prodlike-usw2 2026-03-25T20:50Z to 2026-03-25T22:00Z, scoped key TTL=1h, enable inference logs. ETA 25m.

jason_infra: applying now.

deploy-bot: CR-20260325-113 status: APPLIED by infra-runner at 2026-03-25T20:30:09Z :white_check_mark:

alex_solutions: noted on discount. Sara, I'll send the pricing line to finance once CR shows applied.

sara_sales: thanks all. Please DM me when keys are in the vault so I can hand off to Acme (contact: rachel@acme.com). Will share demo link after verification. :tada:
